questions.question: A train A passes a fixed pole in 24 seconds. The same train completely crosses another train B of length 150 m coming from the opposite direction in 20 seconds. Train B’s speed is 54 km/h. Find the length and the speed of train A.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the speed of **Train A** be SA. Length LA = SA × 24.

Speed of **Train B** = 54 × (5/18) = 15 m/s.

When crossing **Train B** in **opposite direction**: (LA + 150) = (SA + 15) × 20.

Substitute LA: 24SA + 150 = 20SA + 300 ⇒ 4SA = 150.

SA = 37.5 m/s = 37.5 × (18/5) = 135 km/h.

LA = 37.5 × 24 = 900 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 900 m and 135 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time to pass **fixed pole** = 24 sec

Time to cross **Train B** = 20 sec

**Length of Train B** = 150 m

**Speed of Train B** = 54 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Relative Speed (Opposite) = S₁ + S₂

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41583243f703730fcbc9006427181a5679b9a95dff9921590189cebe4efc938a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let **Speed** of **Train A** = v m/s and **Length** of **Train A** = L m.

⇒ From first condition: L = v × 24 → (i)

⇒ Speed of **Train B** in m/s = 54 × (5/18) = 15 m/s.

⇒ From second condition (crossing in **opposite direction**):

⇒ Total Distance = L + 150

⇒ Relative Speed = v + 15

⇒ (L + 150) = (v + 15) × 20 → (ii)

⇒ Substituting (i) in (ii): 24v + 150 = 20v + 300

⇒ 4v = 150 ⇒ v = 37.5 m/s

⇒ Speed of **Train A** in km/h = 37.5 × (18/5) = 135 km/h.

⇒ **Length** of **Train A** = 37.5 × 24 = 900 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 900 m and 135 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

For objects moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂. For opposite directions, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Train Crossing a Pole vs Train

When a train crosses a pole/man, distance = length of train. When it crosses another train/platform, distance = sum of both lengths.

questions.question: ABCD is a quadrilateral in which AB||DC, and E and F are the mid points of the diagonals AC and BD, respectively. If AB = 21 cm, BC = 33 cm, DC = 11 cm, and AD = 52 cm, then what is the length (in cm) of EF?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a **trapezium** (where AB || DC), the length of the segment **EF** joining the **midpoints** of the **diagonals** is half the difference of the parallel sides.

Length of EF = 1/2 × |AB − DC|

⇒ EF = 1/2 × |21 − 11|

⇒ EF = 1/2 × 10 = 5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **AB** = 21 cm, **DC** = 11 cm (Parallel sides), **E** and **F** are midpoints of **AC** and **BD**.

**Formula Used:** Length of segment joining midpoints of diagonals = (1/2) × (Difference of **parallel sides**).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b83cacfa3219eaccd858b08aa8362c71350e18efd0f776e278e061b2b05c21ea.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Parallel side 1 (AB) = 21 cm

⇒ Parallel side 2 (DC) = 11 cm

⇒ Difference of parallel sides = 21 − 11 = 10 cm

⇒ Length of segment EF = (1/2) × 10

⇒ EF = 5 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 5 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median of a Trapezium

The segment joining the midpoints of the non-parallel sides is called the median, and its length is the average of the parallel sides: (AB + DC) ÷ 2.

Midpoint Segment Property

In any quadrilateral, the segment joining the midpoints of the diagonals lies on the median segment joining the midpoints of the non-parallel sides.

Isosceles Trapezium

In an isosceles trapezium, the non-parallel sides (AD and BC) are equal, and the diagonals (AC and BD) are also equal in length.

questions.question: A shopkeeper sells an article for ₹1,200 at a 20% profit. At what price (in ₹) should he sell the article to incur a loss of 10%?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Profit** of 20% means **Selling Price** is 120% of **Cost Price (CP)**.

Given 120% = ₹1,200 ⇒ 1% = ₹10.

For a **Loss** of 10%, the required **Selling Price** is (100 − 10)% = 90%.

Required Price = 90% × 10 = ₹900.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial **Selling Price (SP₁)** = ₹1,200

Initial **Profit%** = 20%

Required **Loss%** = 10%

**Formula Used:**

**Cost Price (CP)** = [SP ÷ (100 + Profit%)] × 100

New **Selling Price (SP₂)** = CP × [(100 − Loss%) ÷ 100]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00dcbef15f1665c91331b58b93b1ad87cb5c035f9a999f912db9386853ea80fd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Cost Price (CP)** = [1,200 ÷ (100 + 20)] × 100

⇒ **CP** = [1,200 ÷ 120] × 100

⇒ **CP** = 10 × 100 = ₹1,000

⇒ **New Selling Price (SP₂)** = 1,000 × [(100 − 10) ÷ 100]

⇒ **SP₂** = 1,000 × (90 ÷ 100)

⇒ **SP₂** = 1,000 × 0.9 = ₹900

**∴ The correct answer is ₹900.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Percentage

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100 and Loss % = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100. Both are always calculated on the **Cost Price** unless specified otherwise.

Marked Price and Discount

**Marked Price (MP)** is the label price. Discount is calculated on MP: **Selling Price (SP)** = MP − Discount.

Successive Profit/Loss

If an article is sold at a% profit and then b% profit, the **Effective Profit %** = [a + b + (a × b)/100]%.

questions.question: Two taps can fill a cistern in 4 hours and 19 hours, respectively. A third tap can empty it in 19 hours. How long (in hours) will it take to fill one-fourth of the empty cistern if all the taps are opened together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The filling rate of the **second tap** (19 hr) and the emptying rate of the **third tap** (19 hr) are identical.

When opened together, they **neutralize** each other's effect completely.

Net filling depends only on the **first tap** which fills the **full cistern** in 4 hours.

Time to fill **one-fourth** of the cistern = 4 hr × (1/4) = 1 hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 hr.**

questions.question: If x is the fourth proportional of 37, 25 and 888, what is the value of x?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ To find the **fourth proportional (x)** of three numbers **a**, **b**, and **c**, use the direct formula: **x = (b × c) ÷ a**. Here, **a = 37**, **b = 25**, and **c = 888**. **x** = (25 × 888) ÷ 37 **x** = 25 × 24 = 600. **∴ The correct answer is 600.**

questions.question: The price of a book is increased from ₹200 to ₹220. What is the percentage increase in the price?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Actual Increase** = ₹220 − ₹200 = ₹20

**Percentage Increase** = (Increase ÷ Original Price) × 100

**Percentage Increase** = (20 ÷ 200) × 100 = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Initial Price** of the book = ₹200

**Final Price** of the book = ₹220

**Formula Used:**

**Percentage Increase** = [(**Final Value** − **Initial Value**) ÷ **Initial Value**] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b232fd14b6a1da034aee27d9afd89627f02b63f21725b026668babd01dd0708.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Price Increase** = ₹220 − ₹200 = ₹20

⇒ **Percentage Increase** = (20 ÷ 200) × 100

⇒ **Percentage Increase** = (1 ÷ 10) × 100

⇒ **Percentage Increase** = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change Formula

The formula for percentage change is [(New Value − Old Value) ÷ Old Value] × 100. If the result is positive, it is an increase; if negative, it is a decrease.

Fraction to Percentage

To convert any fraction into a percentage, multiply it by 100 and add the % symbol. For example, 1/5 × 100 = 20%.

Percentage Base Change

If a value increases from A to B, the base is A. If it decreases from B back to A, the base for calculation becomes B.

questions.question: What least value must be given to n so that the number 5135n2 becomes divisible by 9?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Divisibility rule of 9** states that the sum of the digits must be divisible by 9.

Sum of digits of **5135n2** = 5 + 1 + 3 + 5 + n + 2 = 16 + n

The next higher multiple of 9 after 16 is 18.

⇒ 16 + n = 18 ⇒ n = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The number **5135n2** is completely divisible by 9.

**Formula/Property Used:**

A number is divisible by 9 if and only if the **sum of its digits** is a multiple of 9.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of digits of the number = 5 + 1 + 3 + 5 + n + 2

⇒ Sum of digits = 16 + n

⇒ Since the number is divisible by 9, (16 + n) must be equal to 18, 27, 36, etc.

⇒ For the **least value** of n (where n is a single digit, 0 ≤ n ≤ 9):

⇒ 16 + n = 18

⇒ n = 18 − 16

⇒ n = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3

A number is completely divisible by 3 if the **sum of its digits** is a multiple of 3.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the **difference between the sum of digits at odd places and even places** is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is divisible by 8 if the **number formed by the last three digits** is divisible by 8.

questions.question: If (3⁻²² + 3⁻¹⁹ + 3⁻¹⁷ + 3⁻¹⁶) = k(3⁻²⁴), then find the value of k.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

**Equation:** 3−²² + 3−¹⁹ + 3−¹⁷ + 3−¹⁶ = k × 3−²⁴

**Formula used:**

The **exponent rule** for division: am ÷ aⁿ = am − ⁿ

**Calculations:**

k × 3−²⁴ = 3−²² + 3−¹⁹ + 3−¹⁷ + 3−¹⁶

⇒ k = (3−²² + 3−¹⁹ + 3−¹⁷ + 3−¹⁶) ÷ 3−²⁴

⇒ k = 3⁽−²² − ⁽−²⁴⁾⁾ + 3⁽−¹⁹ − ⁽−²⁴⁾⁾ + 3⁽−¹⁷ − ⁽−²⁴⁾⁾ + 3⁽−¹⁶ − ⁽−²⁴⁾⁾

⇒ k = 3² + 3⁵ + 3⁷ + 3⁸

⇒ k = 9 + 243 + 2187 + 6561

⇒ k = 9000

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question: The sum of two positive numbers is 26 and their product is 144. The positive difference between them is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find two **Factors** of the product **144** that add up to the sum **26**.

List factors: 18 × 8 = 144

Check sum: 18 + 8 = 26 (Matches given sum)

Required **Positive Difference** = 18 − 8 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Sum** (a + b) = 26 and **Product** (ab) = 144

**Formula Used:** (a − b)² = (a + b)² − 4ab

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a137fcabd4d7ef09c8b6ca40ac6ed4a70996ceceb76016ec2e786d8bea5f77a9.png] 

⇒ (a − b)² = (26)² − 4 × 144

⇒ (a − b)² = 676 − 576

⇒ (a − b)² = 100

⇒ a − b = √100

⇒ a − b = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Quadratic Equation Construction

If sum S and product P of two numbers are known, the numbers are roots of x² − Sx + P = 0.

Algebraic Identities

Useful relation: (a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab.

Finding Individual Numbers

Once sum (S) and difference (D) are found, the numbers are (S+D)÷2 and (S−D)÷2.

questions.question: The price of a laptop was initially $1,200. During a sale, the price was first reduced by 20%, and then an additional discount of 15% was applied to the new price. What is the final price of the laptop?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the **successive multiplying factor** for the discounts.

Final Price = **Initial Price** × (100 − d₁)% × (100 − d₂)%

Final Price = 1200 × 80% × 85%

Final Price = 1200 × 0.8 × 0.85 = 816

**∴ The correct answer is 816.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Initial price** of the laptop = 1200

**First discount** percentage = 20%

**Second discount** percentage = 15%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/752cd0cc5f95779a037b005934e6edbc1f1d5896f9434258f9c02409530af322.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Amount of **first discount** = 20% of 1200 = (20/100) × 1200 = 240

⇒ Price after first discount = 1200 − 240 = 960

⇒ Amount of **second discount** = 15% of 960 = (15/100) × 960 = 144

⇒ Final price of the laptop = 960 − 144 = 816

**∴ The correct answer is 816.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Single Equivalent Discount Formula

For two successive discounts of a% and b%, the single effective discount is calculated as (a + b − (a × b)/100)%.

Relationship between MP and SP

Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × (100 − Discount%)/100. Discounts are always applied to the **Marked Price**.

Successive Percentage Change

Final Value = Initial Value × (1 ± r₁/100) × (1 ± r₂/100), where r represents the percentage increase (+) or decrease (−).

questions.question: दो पाइप - A और B, एक टंकी को क्रमशः 20 मिनट और 30 मिनट में भर सकते हैं। एक निकास पाइप C इसे 60 मिनट में खाली कर सकता है। तीनों पाइप एक साथ खोले जाते हैं। 10 मिनट बाद पाइप C को बंद कर दिया जाता है, तो टंकी को भरने में कुल कितना समय लगेगा?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

कुल क्षमता (LCM 20, 30, 60) = 60 इकाई

दक्षता: A = 3, B = 2, C = −1 (निकास)

10 मिनट का कार्य (A+B+C) = (3 + 2 − 1) × 10 = 40 इकाई

शेष कार्य (20 इकाई) भरने में A+B का समय = 20 ÷ 5 = 4 मिनट

कुल समय = 10 + 4 = 14 मिनट

**∴ The correct answer is 14 मिनट.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**दिया गया है:**

पाइप A का समय = 20 मिनट

पाइप B का समय = 30 मिनट

निकास पाइप C का समय = 60 मिनट

**प्रयुक्त सूत्र:**

कुल कार्य = दक्षता × समय

 
 

 **पाइप**
 **समय (मिनट)**
 **कुल कार्य (LCM)**
 **दक्षता**
 
 

 पाइप A
 20
 60 इकाई
 3
 
 

 पाइप B
 30
 2
 
 

 पाइप C
 60
 −1
 
 

**गणना:**

⇒ प्रारंभ में, तीनों पाइप (A, B और C) एक साथ 10 मिनट के लिए खोले जाते हैं।

⇒ 10 मिनट में भरा गया भाग = (3 + 2 − 1) × 10 = 4 × 10 = 40 इकाई

⇒ टंकी का शेष भाग = 60 − 40 = 20 इकाई

⇒ अब **पाइप C** को बंद कर दिया गया है, इसलिए केवल A और B कार्य करेंगे।

⇒ A और B की संयुक्त दक्षता = 3 + 2 = 5 इकाई/मिनट

⇒ शेष भाग को भरने में लगा समय = 20 ÷ 5 = 4 मिनट

⇒ टंकी भरने में लगा **कुल समय** = 10 मिनट + 4 मिनट = 14 मिनट

**∴ The correct answer is 14 मिनट.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

निकास पाइप की दक्षता (Negative Efficiency)

किसी टंकी को खाली करने वाले पाइप की दक्षता को हमेशा ऋणात्मक (−) लिया जाता है, क्योंकि यह कुल भरे हुए भाग को कम करता है।

संयुक्त दक्षता (Combined Efficiency)

जब कई पाइप एक साथ काम करते हैं, तो उनकी कुल दक्षता व्यक्तिगत दक्षताओं का बीजीय योग (Algebraic Sum) होती है।

समय और दक्षता का संबंध

समान कार्य के लिए, समय और दक्षता एक-दूसरे के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होते हैं: समय ∝ 1/दक्षता।

questions.question: Five years ago, Rahul was twice as old as his brother. If Rahul is 10 years older than his brother, what is Rahul’s present age?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

questions.question: Amit and Raghav invest in a business in the ratio 5 : 7. If the total profit is ₹48,000, what is Raghav’s share?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **investment** for **Amit** and **Raghav** = 5 : 7

Total ratio units = 5 + 7 = 12 units

12 units → ₹48,000 (**total profit**)

1 unit → ₹4,000

**Raghav's share** = 7 units = 7 × ₹4,000 = ₹28,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹28,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Investment ratio** (**Amit** : **Raghav**) = 5 : 7

**Total profit** = ₹48,000

**Formula Used:**

Individual **profit share** = (Individual ratio part ÷ Total ratio parts) × **Total profit**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee7357eec5301b844c0e82adc7362fb82e0d68fa7c563a2ea61655c73ae33a37.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total ratio parts = 5 + 7 = 12

⇒ **Raghav's share** = (7 ÷ 12) × 48,000

⇒ **Raghav's share** = 7 × 4,000

⇒ **Raghav's share** = ₹28,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹28,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Partnership Profit Rule

When the **investment time** is the same for all partners, the **profit** is distributed strictly in the **ratio** of their **capital investments**.

Compound Partnership

If partners invest for different time periods, the profit ratio is (C₁ × T₁) : (C₂ × T₂), where C is **capital** and T is **time**.

Ratio to Value Conversion

To find an individual share from a **total value** V and ratio a:b, the share of the first person is [a ÷ (a + b)] × V.

questions.question: If 2^x - 2x⁻¹ = 32 , then the value of (2x-1)/(2x+3) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Equation: 2x − 2x−¹ = 32

**Formula used:**

am − am−ⁿ = am−ⁿ(aⁿ − 1)

**Calculations:**

2x − 2x−¹ = 32

⇒ 2x−¹(2¹ − 1) = 32

⇒ 2x−¹(2 − 1) = 32

⇒ 2x−¹(1) = 32

⇒ 2x−¹ = 2⁵

⇒ x − 1 = 5

⇒ **x = 6**

Now, finding the value of (2x − 1) / (2x + 3) by substituting **x = 6**:

⇒ (2 × 6 − 1) / (2 × 6 + 3)

⇒ (12 − 1) / (12 + 3)

⇒ **11 / 15**

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: A sum of money is invested at a simple interest rate of 8% per annum. After 3 years, the simple interest earned is ₹1,920. What is the principal invested?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Interest Percentage = **Rate** × **Time** = 8% × 3 = 24%.

Given, 24% of the **Principal** = ₹1,920.

Principal (100%) = (1,920 ÷ 24) × 100 = 80 × 100 = ₹8,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Simple Interest (SI)** = ₹1,920, **Rate (R)** = 8% p.a., **Time (T)** = 3 years.

**Formula Used:** SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41d4e7ec29762cf2db4bd3c4e09a48dc2d2ffccb46cf9ea27abeb915d644455c.png] 

⇒ 1,920 = (P × 8 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ 1,920 = (P × 24) ÷ 100

⇒ P × 24 = 1,920 × 100

⇒ P = (1,920 × 100) ÷ 24

⇒ P = 80 × 100

⇒ P = 8,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Principle

**Simple Interest** is always calculated on the original **Principal** amount for every time period, unlike compound interest where interest is added back.

Total Amount Formula

The total **Amount (A)** received at the end of the term is the sum of the Principal and the interest earned: A = P + SI.

Rate and Time Calculations

To find the **Rate (R)**, use R = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T). To find the **Time (T)**, use T = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × R).

questions.question: The L.C.M. of two numbers is 210 and their H.C.F. is 3. If the first number is divided by 3, the quotient is 7 and the remainder is 0. The second number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**First Number** = 3 × 7 = 21

**Second Number** = (LCM × HCF) ÷ First Number

**Second Number** = (210 × 3) ÷ 21 = 10 × 3 = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

L.C.M. = 210

H.C.F. = 3

For the first number: Divisor = 3, Quotient = 7, Remainder = 0

**Formula Used:**

1. Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder

2. Product of two numbers = L.C.M. × H.C.F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cae2c535f1767c40112e51a98b398c28bd2bec079e950d39ae0b8bb046c58dcd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First number = (3 × 7) + 0

⇒ First number = 21

⇒ Let the second number be **x**.

⇒ 21 × x = 210 × 3

⇒ 21 × x = 630

⇒ x = 630 ÷ 21

⇒ x = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Property of LCM & HCF

For any two positive integers a and b, HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b. This property only applies to exactly two numbers.

HCF as a Factor of LCM

The HCF of a set of numbers is always a factor of the LCM of those same numbers.

HCF and LCM of Fractions

HCF of fractions = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators) and LCM of fractions = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators).

questions.question: A daily commuter usually reaches his office on time by driving at a speed of 40 km/hr. One day, due to traffic, he drives at 30 km/hr and reaches 20 minutes late. What is the distance to his office?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Speed** = 40 : 30 = 4 : 3

Since **Distance** is constant, **Time Ratio** = Inverse of Speed Ratio = 3 : 4

Difference in time units = 4 − 3 = 1 unit → 20 minutes

Original time (3 units) = 3 × 20 = 60 minutes = 1 hour

**Distance** = Usual Speed × Usual Time = 40 km/hr × 1 hr = 40 km

**∴ The correct answer is 40 km.**

questions.question: The difference between two numbers is 8. If twice the larger number is 4 more than three times the smaller number, what is the larger number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Test the options for the **larger number**.

If the **larger number** is 20, then the **smaller number** is 20 − 8 = 12.

Condition: Twice the **larger number** = 2 × 20 = 40.

Condition: Three times the **smaller number** + 4 = (3 × 12) + 4 = 36 + 4 = 40.

Since both conditions match (40 = 40), the **larger number** is 20.

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference between two numbers = 8

Let the **larger number** be x and the **smaller number** be y.

**Formula Used:**

Linear equations in two variables: x − y = d and ax + by = c.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/668159abe4248cc28244f33be8b99c12ae94b687ef6be8200cf08b8907e1461e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ x − y = 8

⇒ y = x − 8

⇒ 2x = 3y + 4

⇒ 2x = 3(x − 8) + 4

⇒ 2x = 3x − 24 + 4

⇒ 2x = 3x − 20

⇒ 3x − 2x = 20

⇒ x = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Linear Equation Formulation

Word problems are solved by translating phrases like 'twice' as 2×, 'more than' as +, and 'difference' as subtraction.

Substitution Method

Expressing one variable in terms of another (e.g., y = x − 8) and substituting it into the second equation helps reduce variables.

Verification of Results

Always verify the calculated values in both original conditions to ensure accuracy in algebraic solutions.

questions.question: Which of the expressions given below has the same value as that of cos²(θ) + sin²(θ)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The standard **Trigonometric Identity** is cos²θ + sin²θ = 1.

Another fundamental identity is 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, which implies 1 + tan²θ − sec²θ = 0.

By substituting this into the expression: (1 + tan²θ) + 1 − sec²θ ⇒ sec²θ + 1 − sec²θ = 1.

Since both values equal 1, the expression matches the given condition.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 + tan²(θ) + (1− sec²(θ)).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Primary value = cos²θ + sin²θ

**Formula Used:**

1. **Pythagorean Identity:** sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

2. **Secant Identity:** sec²θ − tan²θ = 1 ⇒ tan²θ − sec²θ = −1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5de555fa8ccf4fb214497e9f253c64d4b8ac4fb11cf5afb83747128e384ef2f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Target value = cos²θ + sin²θ = 1

⇒ Evaluating the expression: 1 + tan²θ + (1 − sec²θ)

⇒ Rearranging terms: (1 + tan²θ) + 1 − sec²θ

⇒ Substitute (1 + tan²θ) = sec²θ

⇒ Result = sec²θ + 1 − sec²θ

⇒ Result = 1

⇒ Since 1 = 1, the values are identical.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 + tan²(θ) + (1− sec²(θ)).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Pythagorean Identities

The three main identities are sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

Key relations: sinθ = 1/cosecθ, cosθ = 1/secθ, and tanθ = 1/cotθ.

Ratio Identities

Tanθ is the ratio of sinθ to cosθ (tanθ = sinθ/cosθ), while cotθ is the inverse (cotθ = cosθ/sinθ).

questions.question: A person spends 75% of his income. If his income increases by 20% and his expenditure increases by 10%, what is the percentage change in his savings?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Expenditure** : **Savings** = 75 : 25 = 3 : 1 (Total = 4 units)

Apply the weighted average rule for percentage increases:

(Total Units × % **Income** Increase) = (Exp Units × % **Exp** Increase) + (Sav Units × % **Sav** Increase)

(4 × 20) = (3 × 10) + (1 × x)

80 = 30 + x ⇒ x = 50%

**∴ The correct answer is 50% increase.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Initial spending = 75% of income. Income increases by 20%, Expenditure by 10%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/474195d35e6b212579d0e937e6e9dbfb1a85d91582c38dc5c1663a6f53738807.png] 

Let **Initial Income** = ₹100

⇒ **Initial Expenditure** = 75% of 100 = ₹75

⇒ **Initial Savings** = Income − Expenditure = 100 − 75 = ₹25

⇒ **New Income** = 100 + (20% of 100) = ₹120

⇒ **New Expenditure** = 75 + (10% of 75) = 75 + 7.5 = ₹82.5

⇒ **New Savings** = New Income − New Expenditure = 120 − 82.5 = ₹37.5

⇒ **Change in Savings** = 37.5 − 25 = ₹12.5

⇒ **Percentage Change** = (12.5 ÷ 25) × 100 = 50%

**∴ The correct answer is 50% increase.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure Formula

Income = Expenditure + Savings. Any increase in income must be balanced by the sum of increases in expenditure and savings.

Weighted Average Method

If components A and B form total T, then % change in T = (A/T × % change in A) + (B/T × % change in B).

Percentage Change

Percentage Increase/Decrease = [(New Value − Old Value) ÷ Old Value] × 100.

questions.question: Three classes have 60, 40, and 50 students respectively. Their average marks are 65, 72, and 60. What is the average mark of all 150 students combined?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of students in three classes = **60 : 40 : 50** = **6 : 4 : 5**.

Assume an average marks of **60**.

Net deviation = (6 × (65 − 60)) + (4 × (72 − 60)) + (5 × (60 − 60)) = 30 + 48 + 0 = **78**.

Average deviation = 78 ÷ (6 + 4 + 5) = 78 ÷ 15 = **5.2**.

Combined average = Assumed Average + Average deviation = 60 + 5.2 = **65.2**.

**∴ The correct answer is 65.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Class 1: **60 students**, Average = **65**

Class 2: **40 students**, Average = **72**

Class 3: **50 students**, Average = **60**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0c24401b427cf9b084075791ac2c7e0b8863867e6e42e58fa8de90e074ab742.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Combined Average = (n₁a₁ + n₂a₂ + n₃a₃) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + n₃)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total marks for Class 1 = 60 × 65 = **3900**

⇒ Total marks for Class 2 = 40 × 72 = **2880**

⇒ Total marks for Class 3 = 50 × 60 = **3000**

⇒ Sum of all marks = 3900 + 2880 + 3000 = **9780**

⇒ Total number of students = 60 + 40 + 50 = **150**

⇒ Combined Average = 9780 ÷ 150

⇒ Combined Average = 978 ÷ 15 = **65.2**

**∴ The correct answer is 65.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

It is an average where each quantity is given a specific weight according to its importance or size. Formula: Average = (Σ wᵢxᵢ) ÷ Σ wᵢ.

Average Property

If each value in a data set is increased or decreased by a constant k, the new average also increases or decreases by k.

Net Deviation Rule

The sum of deviations of all observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero.

questions.question: The 7-digit number 77A444B is divisible by 24. What is the maximum value of (A + B)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A number divisible by **24** must be divisible by both **3** and **8**.

For divisibility by **8**, last three digits **44B** must be divisible by 8 ⇒ **B = 0** or **8**.

For divisibility by **3**, the sum of digits **(26 + A + B)** must be divisible by 3.

To maximize **A + B**, we take the largest possible value **B = 8**.

Now, **26 + A + 8 = 34 + A** must be divisible by 3 ⇒ largest digit **A = 8**.

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The **7-digit number** is **77A444B** and it is divisible by **24**.

**Formula:** If a number is divisible by **24**, it must satisfy the **divisibility rules** for its co-prime factors **3** and **8**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa98720152103db45fc44cc4833037fd5d28fef9c9ce6c5969dddae3aaad8690.png] 

⇒ **Divisibility by 8:** The last three digits **44B** must be divisible by 8.

⇒ 440 + B ÷ 8 ⇒ Since 440 is divisible by 8 (55 × 8), **B** must be **0** or **8**.

⇒ **Divisibility by 3:** The sum of digits **7 + 7 + A + 4 + 4 + 4 + B** must be divisible by 3.

⇒ **26 + A + B** must be a multiple of 3.

⇒ To find the **maximum value** of **(A + B)**, let us test **B = 8** (the maximum possible value for B).

⇒ Sum = 26 + A + 8 = **34 + A**.

⇒ For **34 + A** to be divisible by 3, possible values for A are **2, 5, 8**.

⇒ To maximize the expression, we take **A = 8**.

⇒ **Maximum (A + B) = 8 + 8 = 16**.

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is divisible by 8 if its last three digits are divisible by 8 or if the last three digits are all zeros.

Divisibility Rule of 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of all its individual digits is a multiple of 3.

Composite Divisibility

To check divisibility by a composite number like 24, check divisibility by its co-prime factors (3 and 8 in this case).

questions.question:
A dishonest shopkeeper claims to sell 1 kg of rice at the cost price per kg. He actually uses a weight of 1200 g while purchasing rice, and a weight of 840 g while selling rice. What is the overall percentage profit made by the shopkeeper?

(Round off the result to two decimal places.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Profit Ratio = (Weight actually received while buying / Standard weight) × (Standard weight / Weight actually given while selling)

Net Ratio = (1200 / 1000) × (1000 / 840) = 1200 : 840

Simplified Profit Ratio (SP : CP) = 10 : 7

Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100 = (10 − 7) / 7 × 100 = 3/7 × 100

Profit % = 42.857...% ≈ 42.86%

**∴ The correct answer is 42.86%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Weight obtained by **dishonest shopkeeper** while purchasing = 1200 g (instead of 1000 g)

Weight given by shopkeeper while selling = 840 g (instead of 1000 g)

Let the **Cost Price (CP)** of 1 g of rice be ₹1.

While purchasing, he pays for 1000 g but gets 1200 g.

⇒ Actual CP for 1200 g = ₹1000

⇒ CP of 1 g = 1000 / 1200 = ₹5/6

While selling, he charges for 1000 g (at CP) but gives only 840 g.

⇒ Selling Price (SP) of 840 g = ₹1000

⇒ SP of 1 g = 1000 / 840 = ₹25/21

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/253c08ea9418fbc08195632437e386427d2d03b2d1ec38d60417f91821c7f33b.png] 

**Overall percentage profit:**

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = (25/21) − (5/6)

⇒ Profit = (50 − 35) / 42 = 15/42 = 5/14

⇒ Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (5/14) / (5/6) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (5/14) × (6/5) × 100 = 6/14 × 100 = 3/7 × 100

⇒ Profit % = 42.857...%

**∴ The correct answer is 42.86%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Formula

When a dealer sells at cost price but uses a false weight, Profit % = [Error / (True Value − Error)] × 100.

Combined Cheating (Buying and Selling)

If a dealer cheats by x% while buying and y% while selling, the net gain ratio is [(100+x)/100] × [100/(100−y)].

Successive Percentage Change

For successive profits of a% and b%, the effective profit is [a + b + (a × b)/100]%, though the ratio method is safer for weight errors.

questions.question: A cylindrical pipe has an external radius of 8 cm and an internal radius of 7 cm. If its length is 20 cm, what is the volume of material used in the pipe? (Use π = 3.14)
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ **Volume of material** in a pipe = π × h × (R + r) × (R − r) Given: R = 8 cm, r = 7 cm, h = 20 cm, π = 3.14 Volume = 3.14 × 20 × (8 + 7) × (8 − 7) Volume = 3.14 × 20 × 15 × 1 = 3.14 × 300 = 942 **∴ The correct answer is 942 cubic cm.**

questions.question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹1,320 in 4 years at 12% per year rate of interest?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ The **Effective Interest Rate** for 4 years at 12% is: 12% × 4 = 48%. Since 48% of the **Principal** equals the **Simple Interest** of ₹1,320. **Principal** (100%) = (1,320 ÷ 48) × 100 = 27.5 × 100 = 2,750. **∴ The correct answer is ₹2,750.**

questions.question: एक पेन की कीमत ₹47 है। एक स्कीम "4 खरीदें, और 1 पर 50% की छूट पाएं" का ऑफर देती है। प्रति पेन की प्रभावी कीमत ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

कुल **पेनों की संख्या** = 4 + 1 = 5

कुल लागत = (4 × 47) + (47 का 50%)

कुल लागत = 188 + 23.5 = ₹211.5

प्रभावी कीमत = 211.5 ÷ 5 = ₹42.30

**∴ The correct answer is ₹42.30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**दिया गया है:**

एक पेन की कीमत = ₹47

स्कीम: 4 पेन खरीदें और 1 अतिरिक्त पेन पर **50% की छूट** पाएं।

**सूत्र:**

प्रभावी कीमत = कुल भुगतान / कुल वस्तुओं की संख्या

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d236604066fe5f54e8fdd1b7892a71819897f7d53504edf158cfb1639a9986f.png] 

**गणना:**

⇒ 4 पेन की लागत = 4 × 47 = ₹188

⇒ 5वें पेन पर छूट = 47 का 50% = 47 × (50/100) = ₹23.50

⇒ 5वें पेन की रियायती कीमत = 47 − 23.50 = ₹23.50

⇒ कुल 5 पेनों के लिए भुगतान की गई कुल राशि = 188 + 23.50 = ₹211.50

⇒ प्रति पेन प्रभावी कीमत = 211.50 ÷ 5

⇒ प्रति पेन प्रभावी कीमत = ₹42.30

**∴ The correct answer is ₹42.30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

प्रभावी छूट प्रतिशत (Effective Discount %)

इस प्रकार की योजनाओं में प्रभावी छूट ज्ञात करने के लिए: (कुल छूट / कुल अंकित मूल्य) × 100। इस प्रश्न में छूट = ₹23.5 और कुल अंकित मूल्य = 5 × 47 = ₹235। प्रभावी छूट % = (23.5 / 235) × 100 = 10%।

Buy X Get Y Free

यदि योजना 'Buy 4 Get 1 Free' होती, तो प्रभावी छूट % = [1 / (4 + 1)] × 100 = 20% होती।

अंकित मूल्य और विक्रय मूल्य

विक्रय मूल्य (SP) = अंकित मूल्य (MP) − छूट (Discount)। यहाँ ₹42.30 प्रत्येक पेन का प्रभावी विक्रय मूल्य है।
